title: Enterprise AI & Automation Briefing
summary: Enterprise AI is concentrating on governed context and controllable execution. Workday plans to add a semantic layer so agents query live business data with consistent definitions; Microsoft and Salesforce put permissioned CRM context and actions into Copilot; and Microsoft’s new transparency initiative addresses the evidence gap around agent behavior with enterprise partners.

stocks.name: Workday, Inc.
stocks.role: governed enterprise-data context for AI agents
stocks.does: Provides cloud software for human capital management, finance, and enterprise operations.
stocks.briefing: Workday announced its intent to acquire Honeydew, aiming to embed a semantic layer in Workday Data Cloud so AI agents can turn business requests into deterministic, permission-aware queries against live data.

stocks.name: Microsoft Corporation
stocks.role: enterprise AI, productivity, data, and governance platform
stocks.does: Provides Azure cloud infrastructure, Copilot AI products, Microsoft 365 productivity software, Teams, Fabric, and security tools.
stocks.briefing: Microsoft announced Copilotforce with Salesforce, connecting governed CRM context and permitted actions to Copilot, Teams, and Fabric; it also launched the AI Transparency Initiative to improve evidence, security, and governance around models and agents.

stocks.name: Salesforce, Inc.
stocks.role: CRM data and workflow platform for enterprise AI
stocks.does: Provides customer relationship management software, data platforms, and business workflow tools.
stocks.briefing: Salesforce co-launched Copilotforce, with Salesforce in Copilot available in public preview and two-way zero-copy data integrations between Data 360 and Microsoft Fabric for governed customer-data access.

stocks.name: Accenture plc
stocks.role: enterprise AI implementation and systems-integration partner
stocks.does: Provides consulting, technology, and managed services across enterprise operations and digital transformation.
stocks.briefing: Accenture is the design and implementation partner and pilot customer for Copilotforce, deploying the integrations in its global sales organization; it also joined Microsoft’s AI Transparency Initiative.

stocks.name: Adobe Inc.
stocks.role: enterprise software and AI transparency initiative participant
stocks.does: Provides creative, document, and customer-experience software and AI-enabled enterprise applications.
stocks.briefing: Adobe is among the organizations participating in Microsoft’s AI Transparency Initiative, which seeks shared approaches to visibility, verification, security, and governance for enterprise AI agents.

stocks.name: Mastercard Incorporated
stocks.does: Provides global payment-network technology and data services.
stocks.briefing: Mastercard is among the enterprise organizations participating in Microsoft’s AI Transparency Initiative, a cross-industry effort focused on transparent and accountable AI models and agents.

stocks.name: Volvo Car AB
stocks.does: Designs, manufactures, and sells passenger vehicles and related mobility services.
stocks.briefing: Volvo Cars is among the organizations participating in Microsoft’s AI Transparency Initiative, extending the briefing’s governance theme beyond technology vendors to an industrial enterprise adopter.
